subject: SIG kickoff & clarifying asks — Medistride security intake
body:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: James Li <james.li@medistride.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medistride.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: SIG kickoff & clarifying asks — Medistride security intake

Hi James / Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the Medistride security and engineering leads. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the questionnaire efficiently: 

- Scope check: you mentioned SOC 2 is in flight and there are HIPAA considerations for certain flows. Can you confirm the products/environments that will handle PHI? (prod only / prod + staging / other)
- Target compliance artifacts: are you looking for a SOC 2 Type II report once available and a BAA for HIPAA?
- Questionnaire choice: our standard path is SIG-Lite for early-stage intake; SIG-Full if you want granular control evidence mapped to controls. Do you have a preference?
- Evidence & network info: to accelerate, can you share a simple inventory (app list, data categories), current network diagram, and any EDR/KMS vendor names?
- Timeline: what procurement window are you targeting for an initial security review (2–8 weeks)?

If you confirm the above, I’ll open the SIG in our portal and share a prefill spreadsheet (it’s faster if you can fill high-level entries and attach a couple artifacts). Rishi will be the security engineer on our side for evidence questions; I’ll own coordination.

Attachments: none on this message — I’ll attach the prefill template in my kickoff email once you confirm scope.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

-----Original Message-----
From: James Li <james.li@medistride.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medistride.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:02:13 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff & clarifying asks — Medistride security intake

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the clear recap — confirms on our side. Quick answers inline: 

- PHI scope: production only (the patient-facing API and scheduled messaging service will touch PHI). Staging uses synthetic/test data.
- Compliance artifacts: we are in the process of a SOC 2 Type II audit, expected completion target is Aug 2027. We will need a BAA signed before handling production PHI.
- Questionnaire: SIG-Lite sounds fine to start; if you recommend SIG-Full based on our answers we can expand.
- Evidence & network: attaching a quick inventory export (medistride-inventory.csv) and I can get the network diagram next. We use Keylox KMS (hosted) and Sentinel EDR.
- Timeline: procurement expects to complete security review + contract in ~6 weeks, but we can be flexible if additional evidence required.

Attachment: medistride-inventory.csv (CSV, 24 KB)

Appreciate you kicking this off.

—James
James Li
Head of Security Operations | Medistride
james.li@medistride.com | +1 206-555-0987

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff & clarifying asks — Medistride security intake

Great, thanks James — attaching our SIG prefill template and a short intake checklist to make the first pass quicker. We’ll start with SIG-Lite given SOC 2 is in flight; we can expand if any items map poorly.

What I’m asking from you for the initial kickoff: 
- Quick prefill of the spreadsheet (redwood-sig-prefill.xlsx) — high-level app names, who manages them, and which process/store PHI. Estimated time: 30–60 minutes.
- Network diagram (high-level) + confirmation of KMS vendor (you provided Keylox) and EDR (Sentinel).
- Point of contact for procurement/security evidence: please confirm whether Priya or someone else owns package delivery.

Rishi will be our primary security engineer for evidence triage — he’ll follow up on specific control-level asks once we have the prefill. I’ve added a link to the intake form in case you prefer uploading artifacts via our portal: https://drive.redwood.com/secure/medistride/sig-prefill

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill.xlsx (Excel, 18 KB)

Next actions: James — if you can return the prefill + the network diagram by EOD Wed (14 Apr), we’ll open the SIG ticket and send a prioritized evidence request list the same day. If your procurement window is tighter than 6 weeks, flag it and we’ll escalate.

Thanks,
Olga

On Tue, Apr 13, 2027 at 10:11 AM James Li <james.li@medistride.com> wrote:
> Thanks Olga — a couple quick clarifying questions before we fill the template: 
> 
> 1) For backups, what is the minimum artifact you need to show periodic restore testing? Is a quarterly restore test log + runbook sufficient?
> 2) For encryption at rest in your recommendations, does Redwood accept KMS-managed keys (Keylox) with customer-managed rotation, or do you require an HSM-backed key for production?
> 
> I can attach a rough network diagram (PDF) and confirm procurement contact after verifying with Priya.
> 
> —James

-----Original Message-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: James Li <james.li@medistride.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medistride.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff & clarifying asks — Medistride security intake

Hi James — quick answers to your two questions: 

1) Backups: a quarterly restore test log plus a runbook is a good baseline for SIG-Lite. For SIG-Full we sometimes ask for evidence of the last restore attempt artifacts (tickets) and a photo of the runbook execution. We’ll flag if we need the extra.
2) Encryption: KMS-managed keys with customer-managed rotation (Keylox) are acceptable. HSM-backed keys are not required for SIG-Lite, but if you have regulatory constraints that mandate HSM we’ll note that in the evidence requests.

I’ll also note that for PHI we will require a signed BAA before production cutover; we can start reviewing technical controls in parallel.

—Rishi
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
